bio: I'm a passionate Fullstack Developer based in Vietnam with over 3 years of programming experience, specializing in building responsive, high-performance web applications. I love turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions.

I've worked at companies like Peraichi, AIHELLO, and Trudi AI on diverse projects ranging from e-commerce platforms and AI-powered services to Amazon seller tools. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and take on challenging projects that push my skills to the next level.
When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new tech, contributing to open-source projects, or writing about web development best practices.
